sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT
        1
      FROM
        posting_skills AS ps
      WHERE
        ps.posting_key = fp.posting_key AND ps.skill = 'RAG'
    ) THEN 'Mentions RAG'
    ELSE 'Does not mention RAG'
  END AS rag_mention_status,
  median(fp.comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay_midpoint_usd
FROM
  fct_posting AS fp
WHERE
  fp.is_open
  AND fp.remote_us
  AND fp.is_canonical_listing
  AND fp.comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  rag_mention_status;
